# newui

A SolidJS component library — the equivalent of frappe-ui rebuilt on **SolidJS +
Zag + Tailwind CSS v4**, themed with Frappe's design tokens. Ship tier: prod.

## Packages

- `@newui/tokens` — framework-neutral token data + CSS-variable generator (leaf).
- `@newui/tailwind` — v4 `@theme`/`@utility`/plugins + `style.css`.
- `@newui/icons` — Frappe's glyphs as Solid components.
- `@newui/ui` — components over Zag, `tv()` recipes, and the `lib/` shims.

## Conventions (short)

- **Two colour axes only**: `variant` (`solid | subtle | outline | ghost`) and
  `theme` (`gray | blue | green | amber | red`; Badge adds `violet`). State
  (error/disabled/loading) is a state prop, never a theme.
- **No `v-model`.** Overlays take `open` + `onOpenChange`; inputs take `value` +
  `onValueChange` (or `checked` + `onCheckedChange`). Uncontrolled via
  `default*`.
- **Every input shares the labelling contract** (P5): `label`, `description`,
  `error`, `required` — implemented by `Field`.
- **Styling hooks are `data-slot` / `data-state`**, never class-injection props.
  Root `class` fallthrough is merged last with `cn()`.
- **Semantic tokens only** — `surface-*`, `ink-*`, `outline-*`. Never raw colours.
- Light/dark is the `colorScheme` axis (`createColorScheme`), not `theme`.

## Components

Alert · AppShell (+PageHeader/PageBody) · Avatar · Badge · BottomSheet ·
Breadcrumbs · Button · Card · Checkbox · Combobox · ContextMenu · DatePicker ·
DesktopShell · Dialog · Divider · Dropdown · Duration · ErrorMessage ·
FileUploader · FormControl · FormLabel · HoverCard · Icon · ItemListRow ·
KeyboardShortcut · KeyboardShortcutsDialog · List · Menu · MobileShell
(+MobileNav/PageHeaderMobile) · MultiSelect · NumberInput · Password · Popover ·
Progress · RadioGroup (alias `Radio`) · Rating · ScrollArea · Select ·
SettingsDialog · Sidebar · Skeleton · Slider · Spinner · Switch · TabButtons ·
Tabs · Textarea · TextInput · TimePicker · Toast · Tooltip · Tree.

Per-component contracts live in [`spec/`](./spec). API tables are generated into
`packages/ui/api.json`. The data layer lives in `@newui/ui`'s `lib/resource/`:
`request`/`setConfig`, `createResource`/`createListResource`/
`createDocumentResource`, `useCall`/`useDoc`/`useList`/`useDoctype`/`useNewDoc`,
plus `createLocalStore`/`createIdbStore`/`createRealtime`. Imperative dialogs:
`dialog.confirm`/`dialog.danger`/`dialog.prompt` + `<DialogHost />`.

## Commands

```
pnpm dev             # playground
pnpm build           # build all packages
pnpm test            # vitest (unit + a11y + manifest)
pnpm test:ssr        # Solid SSR smoke tests
pnpm verify          # the whole CI pipeline locally (15 steps)
pnpm verify:checks   # fast gates only
pnpm verify:e2e      # browser harness only
pnpm css             # regenerate @theme + tokens CSS after token changes
pnpm api             # regenerate packages/ui/api.json
pnpm docs:build      # render spec/*.md + api.json into a static docs/ site
```
